periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation tilting approximately 40 degrees downward from the lateral edges toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Teardrop-shaped ovals with a length-to-width ratio of approximately 1.8:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward tapering at the medial-inferior margin, shifting the visual weight toward the muzzle.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation across the superior-most arc of the cranium.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, reddish-brown particulates or spots distributed across the white fur of the forehead and crown.
